rv.q: His superb staging is as rich in detail as it is austere in execution.
Two decades later, I was to catch that same revelation again on seeing opera live – no surprise as Sweeney sits more than most shows in the intersection of the Musical Theatre/Opera Venn diagram.
Murphy has excelled in creating a vibrant, new version that puts the music at the fore.
Completely flawless, you can forget the worst pies in London, Sweeney Todd is unquestionably the best show in Birmingham.
Birmingham Rep has given it the revival it deserves.
The material shines enduringly, as do its performances.
An intimate yet chilling revival - and a solid introduction for those new to Sondheim’s darker works.

cn.t: Critics praise this captivating Birmingham Rep revival of Sondheim's masterpiece, highlighting Joe Murphy's superb atmospheric staging, tremendous vocal performances from Ramin Karimloo and Meow Meow, and its blend of dark gothic humor with gripping storytelling.
